proposed_tools.name: search_capabilities_tool
proposed_tools.adapter_scope: decode structured query and serialize candidates
proposed_tools.description: Start here. Search the installed FlagQuantum capability catalog with a structured query; an empty query lists the bounded local research candidates. This tool discovers capabilities only and does not execute quantum work.

proposed_tools.name: describe_capability_tool
proposed_tools.adapter_scope: decode identity and serialize the versioned manifest
proposed_tools.description: Read the exact installed manifest before preparing a call. Use its request, result, validator, target, limitation, and schema identities; do not infer support from the tool description.

proposed_tools.name: estimate_capability_tool
proposed_tools.adapter_scope: decode typed request and serialize the upstream estimate
proposed_tools.description: Estimate the bounded request with FlagQuantum before execution. The returned resource estimate is authoritative for this capability; the MCP adapter adds no quantum cost model.

proposed_tools.name: validate_capability_input_tool
proposed_tools.adapter_scope: decode typed request and preserve the upstream report
proposed_tools.description: Validate the complete typed request with FlagQuantum before execution. Continue only when the upstream report passes; MCP transport success is not an applicability decision.

proposed_tools.name: execute_local_capability_tool
proposed_tools.adapter_scope: local execution only; forward provider order and fallback authorization verbatim; serialize evidence losslessly
proposed_tools.description: Execute one previously described, estimated, and validated capability on the bounded local CPU path only. Pass provider_order exactly and set allow_provider_fallback explicitly for more than one provider. Inspect the returned Evidence Bundle status and validators, then call validate_evidence_tool; transport success is not scientific success.

proposed_tools.name: validate_evidence_tool
proposed_tools.adapter_scope: decode evidence and preserve the upstream validation report
proposed_tools.description: Validate a returned Evidence Bundle with the installed FlagQuantum validator. Preserve the report for independent client or researcher acceptance; this tool does not turn transport completion into a scientific conclusion.

proposed_resources.adapter_scope: serialize the installed structured capability index
serve the exact installed JSON Schema document without redefinition

tool_response_envelope.result_policy: serialize the exact upstream operation result under result without field omission or renaming, including every embedded structured domain error field
tool_response_envelope.error_policy: the error envelope is only for adapter or pre-result public API exceptions; domain errors returned inside reports or Evidence Bundles remain in success results
tool_response_envelope.domain_failure_policy: an upstream Evidence Bundle with failed, validation_failed, or unsupported status remains a transport-success result and is never rewritten as an MCP transport error

rules.message_policy: use the public API exception message
report that the installed FlagQuantum SDK is unavailable

required_decisions: select an exact installed capability id and version from discovery
use the installed manifest and schema resources rather than inferred fields
stop when estimation or input validation does not pass
authorize every provider and unavailable-only fallback explicitly
treat Evidence Bundle validators and independent client policy as scientific gates

compatibility.activation_condition: a published FlagQuantum wheel contains the approved research service API and an adapter wheel is verified against it

activation_readiness_contract.scope: read-only external prerequisites; passing does not register tools or prove adapter equivalence

existing_overlap.disposition: retain for existing generic planning and training tools; capability adapters must not call or extend it
retain for the existing generic training tool; capability adapters use upstream typed requests and estimates
retain protocol safety limits only; never translate them into scientific resource estimates

activation_gates: upstream maturity is production_supported or release_certified
parameter and default forwarding contract passes
evidence and error losslessness contract passes
provider routing and fallback forwarding contract passes
direct Python and MCP results are equivalent
no research capability tool is registered before every gate passes
